`exhaust_fixpoint_test.exs`), the ECMAScript backend's expression emitter ported over the literal/unary/binary slice (`selfhost_js.rian` equals `Rian.JS` term-for-term; `js_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **Kotlin/JVM and ECMAScript backends fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_jvm.rian` = `Rian.JVM.compile`, `selfhost_js.rian` = `Rian.JS.compile` — whole-module emission incl. sum types + multi-clause pattern dispatch + case/tuples/lists; `jvm_module_fixpoint_test.exs`/`js_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **BEAM backend fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_beam.rian` — whole-module abstract forms with native multi-clause dispatch — compiles via `:compile.forms` and runs identically to `Rian.Beam`; `beam_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **Rust backend fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_rust.rian` — whole-module emission with `enum`s + match-over-param-tuple dispatch + capability-lowered signatures — equals `Rian.Lower.rust_program`; `rust_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), a slice of the real type checker ported (`selfhost_checker.rian` agrees with `Rian.Check.infer` over ALL 12 Core nodes + the whole fixpoint domain — literals incl. float/char, ids in a typing env, operand-directed + cross-width arithmetic, prim + higher-order calls, `if`/`case`/list LUB (with flow narrowing + parametric covariant join), and lambdas (`Fn(...)`); Honest scope: this is `v1==v2` **for the Rian compiler — self-COMPILING and now PARTIALLY self-CHECKING**, compared on forms (the canonical artifact). The two **structural gates are wired into the build loop** — `build` refuses a non-exhaustive sum dispatch (verified `SelfhostExhaust`, env from the program's `type` decls) and a BEAM-illegal `ref` parameter (verified `SelfhostCap.beam_legal`), both via `:erlang.error` (`compose_exhaust_gate_fixpoint_test.exs`). It is **not** a claim that `build` reproduces `Rian.Beam`'s bytecode — `Rian.Beam` additionally emits `-spec`/type attributes and runs Reach, so the host artifact is richer by design; **full** self-CHECKING (Rian.Check type inference also in the loop, the checker port now covers 12/12 Core nodes — a typing env, operand-directed arithmetic, and `if`-branch LUB — its remaining gap being generic-return instantiation (`ic.fsigs`) + ctor-pattern field narrowing (`ic.tdefs`)) remains the next terminus. +  # a generic function (`ic.fsigs[f]` with type variables) instantiates its return
